Description: Shades of myriad beasts await all who attempt the Crucible of the Unbroken, a tool conceived by a certain tradition of beastmasters. Navigating these intricately crafted boards requires no little skill and fortitude─especially should your soul be on the line. Hold fast to your teachings and to the bonds with your familiars as you weather the trials within...

Thanks to your unparalleled skill and unwavering faith, Lauda and Guttler have embarked together upon a different path. The Crucible has been reimagined into training grounds for beast and mankind alike, allowing all to freely hone their skills in battle. Join the joyful fray and realize your true potential as a beastmaster!
